    Given the business rules of section 8 of this document
    When the contract is validated against them
    Then BR1 declares the restore to a new server at one timestamp for both databases, never in place on the live server
    Then BR2 declares the restore and failover measures as configuration, never set in code or in the document
    Then BR3 declares the consistency check refusal, no worker start and the drill recorded as failed with both timestamps
    Then BR4 declares the archive lead time and the retention as parameters
    Then BR5 declares the write-once archive, one manifest row per file and the path as the key
    Then BR6 declares codec-encrypted payloads only, the FAILED row and the incident
    Then BR7 declares the one minor version upgrade order and the pinned version record
    Then BR8 declares the drill result as release evidence, with a failed drill blocking the release
